items.title: 9.7 Uniform (ek jaisa) electric field mein charged particles (zarra) ki motion (harkat) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.7 with Fig. 9.17 (PDF 205-206).

blocks.text: Ulte charges wali do parallel (mutawazi) metal (dhaat) ki plates apne darmiyan uniform electric field banati hain. Field ki direction (rukh) positive (musbat) plate se negative (manfi) plate ki taraf hoti hai. Field mein rakha positive charge +q field ki direction mein chalta hai, jabke negative charge −q field ke ulat chalta hai. Charge q par electric force ki magnitude (Fig. 9.17):
Yahan E uniform field ki intensity hai. Agar plates ke darmiyan potential difference V aur plates ka faasla d ho to:

blocks.alt: Do horizontal (ufuqi) hari plates, oopar + aur neeche -, faasla d, voltage V ki battery se juri. Magenta lines E neeche. Dairay wala + charge q, surkh teer neeche; dairay wala - charge q, hara teer oopar.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.17 (kitab ki Figure 9.17 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Positive charge field ki direction (neeche, − plate ki taraf) aur negative charge field ke ulat (oopar, + plate ki taraf) chalta hai. Field E = V/d hai.

Uniform field ka charged particles ki motion par asar samajhne ke liye plates ke darmiyan ek electron lein. Us par lagne wali force F ki wajah se electron positive plate ki taraf tez hota (accelerate) jata hai.
Maan lein V = 20 V aur d = 2.0 cm = 2 × 10⁻² m. To E ki magnitude (miqdar):
Electron ka acceleration Newton ke second law F = ma se:
Electron ka charge q = e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C aur mass m = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg hai. Is liye:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Yeh acceleration zameen ki gravity (9.8 m s⁻²) se taqreeban 10¹³ guna zyada hai, kyun ke electron ka mass bohat hi kam hai. Isi liye electron par gravity ko ignore (nazar-andaz) kar dete hain.
Agar electron negative plate se rest (aaram) se chhora jaye to positive plate tak pohanch kar us ki velocity third equation of motion (motion ki teesri equation) se milti hai:
Yahan S = d = 2 × 10⁻² m, vᵢ = 0 aur v_f = v (maloom karni hai). Qeematein rakhein:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab v² = 7.04 m² s⁻² likhti hai; 10¹² ka factor reh gaya hai. Sahi: v² = 7.04 × 10¹² m² s⁻², jis se kitab ka jawab v = 2.65 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹ hi aata hai.

blocks.caption: Plates ke darmiyan electron (V = 20 V, d = 2.0 cm): khulasa
rows: Aaram se chal kar v (2aS = v²)

blocks.prompt: Ek electron uniform field E = 300 N C⁻¹ mein vᵢ = 2.99 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹ ki velocity se (field ke seedha) dakhil hota hai; plates 10.0 cm lambi hain. Us ka acceleration aur field se guzarne ka waqt nikalein (numerical 9.5).
blocks.explanation: a = eE/m = (1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ × 300)/(9.1 × 10⁻³¹) = 5.27 × 10¹³ m s⁻² (direction E ke ulat; isi liye kitab ke jawab mein minus sign hai). Horizontal velocity nahi badalti, is liye t = 0.100 m/(2.99 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹) = 3.34 × 10⁻⁸ s.

items: Ulte charges wali plates ke darmiyan field uniform, + se − ki taraf; positive charge E ke saath, negative E ke ulat chalta hai.
2.0 cm par 20 V: E = 1000 N C⁻¹, a = 1.76 × 10¹⁴ m s⁻²; aaram se chala electron positive plate tak 2.65 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹ par pohanchta hai.
